record.question: Which of the following would come under capital expenditure?
record.explanation: Answer D: Purchase of tools and machinery. Purchasing tools and machinery creates/acquires assets and is capital expenditure; wages, rent and repairs are revenue expenditure. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/budget2024-25/doc/bs.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
